prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, legendary bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide; a mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body, the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it; below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves; her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust; the bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long straight balayage hair — wearing a minimal black leather micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, paired with a micro strapless black leather bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, leaving the curve of her bust visible above and below it, her stomach fully visible below it. Pose: walking confidently toward the camera, shoulders back, chin lifted — most extreme legendary bust silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her whole hand, in glossy black leather with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.

Background: a sunlit open-air stone terrace at midday with a pale paved floor, a waist-high balustrade, potted palms and a standard-height doorway, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
